All-Weather Track race cancelled at Sha Tin due to rain - another under threat
The Hong Kong Jockey Club abandoned the sixth race at Sha Tin on Saturday after jockeys complained of poor visibility in Race 3 on the rain-soaked all-weather track. Track staff are now working to save Race 10, and officials will make a call after an inspection following Race 8.
